functions.name: ScreenToWidgetLocal
functions.signature: ScreenToWidgetLocal(World Context Object, Geometry, Screen Position, Local Coordinate, Include Window Position)
functions.docs:
Translates a screen position in pixels into the local space of a widget with the given geometry.
If bIncludeWindowPosition is true, then this method will also remove the game window's position (useful when in windowed mode).

functions.name: ScreenToWidgetAbsolute
functions.signature: ScreenToWidgetAbsolute(World Context Object, Screen Position, Absolute Coordinate, Include Window Position)
functions.docs:
Translates a screen position in pixels into absolute application coordinates.
If bIncludeWindowPosition is true, then this method will also remove the game window's position (useful when in windowed mode).
